prompt: A whimsical, hand-drawn illustration in a storybook style depicts a chaotic scene on a telephone wire. On the left, a large, frantic black crow with wide, bulging eyes and an open beak is perched on the wire, its wings spread in agitation. To the right of the crow, a bright yellow balloon is caught on the wire and has just burst, with jagged yellow shards flying outward in all directions against a backdrop of fluffy white clouds and blue sky. Below the wire, the tops of several European-style rooftops are visible, featuring red tiles and chimneys. The artwork uses textured lines and watercolor-like shading.

promptZh: 这幅充满奇思妙想的手绘插图采用故事书风格，描绘了电话线上的一幕混乱场景。左侧，一只体型硕大、神情慌张的黑乌鸦栖息在线上，双眼圆睁凸出，喙部张开，翅膀因激动而展开。在乌鸦右侧，一个明亮的黄色气球卡在电线上并刚刚爆裂，锯齿状的黄色碎片向四面八方飞散，背景是蓬松的白云和蓝天。电线下方，可以看到几座欧式建筑的屋顶顶部，配有红色瓦片和烟囱。该艺术作品运用了富有质感的线条和水彩般的阴影处理。
